# System {#sec-system}

For the personal computers, mainly is using Windows or MacOS. While in the bioinformatics field, the main operation system is **Linux**.

Linux, same as MacOS, is the Unix-baed operation system, so some part of the commands are similar between them. Bioinformatics use Linx as the main operation due to Linux is **Free**, **Dev-free**, and most of the bioinfo packages are develop by Linux. Also, the server is also main the Linux-based environment.
